free_tier.stated: Free registered accounts have a limited storage allowance of unpublished size. Ultimate (paid): EUR 39.99 for 365 days (EUR 3.33/month), advertised as 'Unlimited Storage' on the pricing page while the terms state Ultimate has a maximum storage allowance per account.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Files are deleted after no access for 5 days (upload without an account), 7 days (app guest account without an email address), 60 days (registered account without Ultimate) or 120 days (Ultimate).

egress.terms: Ultimate 200 GB/day download traffic (195 GB/account/day per the published conditions); free is speed-limited, gated by a human-verification step, single-stream, with daily limits. No per-GB price.

tooling: Apps for Android/iOS/TV/browser extension, JDownloader/IDM compatible, documented API referenced in the published conditions ('outside the documented API').
chaining: Only the paid tier reaches unlimited, so this is a EUR 40/year route to unlimited storage rather than a free one. Email-only signup; the published conditions state that several accounts used to skip the limits are outside the allocation.

limits.value: Ultimate has a maximum storage allowance per account; the figure is not published
delete after 7 days without access (app guest account without an email address); 60 days registered; 120 days Ultimate

limits_note: Free: unpublished storage allowance, 60-day deletion after no access. Ultimate: unlimited storage, 120-day retention, 195-200 GB/day download. Guest accounts (app, no email) delete after 7 days. Copy/import throttles: 1,000 files/hour, torrent 4 jobs/hour, 25 GB/job.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose: hrottles: 1,000 files/hour, torrent 4 jobs/hour, 25 GB/job. anonymous-dump

reliability_note: The marketing meta tag says 'Unlimited Storage, Unlimited File Size' while clause 3.3 of the published conditions says the opposite for Ultimate ('does not include unlimited bandwidth, unlimited storage or unlimited downloads'). Trust the published conditions: free accounts have a cap that is simply not disclosed.
